The program recently hired two nationally recognized experts in art education, Aaron Knochel from Penn State University (program director) and Daniel Barney from George Mason University (graduate program director) to guide the next phase of art education. archive.summary: MIT researchers developed X-Hinges, software that helps design 3D-printed objects with built-in sensors. The tricky part is separating the sensors’ signals from interference caused by the wire-like connections around them. The tool places two different materials in the design to reduce that interference. The researchers describe objects such as lamps and gloves that respond to touch, as well as small robots and toys. It is an understandable electronics problem: make an object sense what someone is doing, then get a clear signal out of it.

archive.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
archive.summary: Nearly 1,000 arrests were made as hundreds of thousands of people took part in another day of protests across France which were followed by some clashes late on Saturday, officials have said. After a day of largely peaceful demonstrations, police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse protesters in a number of cities including Paris, while barricades were set alight in Marseille and people ripped boards from a shop in Bordeaux. But officials have so far managed to avoid rioting and looting on the scale seen last weekend, which resulted in some of the worst scenes of disorder in France's modern history.
